presets.title: Static Autolint + Disk Growth Check
presets.description:
Use skill /hk-static-autolint to perform Static Autolint + Disk Growth Check.

Run the repo linters, autofix what is safe on this branch, and file a task only for findings that need human judgment. Also check disk/log/worktree growth so the kit doesn't silently accumulate cruft.

WHY: health checks are hand-rolled and preset infrastructure sits underused. This preset makes periodic static cleanup run the same way on any project, turning lint output into either an automatic fix or a properly-briefed task — no re-deriving the questions each time.

Scope
1. Lint the Python surface (ruff). From the repo root:
   - `ruff check odin/ taskit/taskit-backend/ harness_usage_status/`
   - Autofix the safe set in place: `ruff check --fix` then `ruff format` (import sorting, unused imports, formatting). These are deterministic and reversible; apply them directly on the branch.
2. Lint the frontend surface (eslint):
   - `cd taskit/taskit-frontend && npm run lint`
   - Run `npm run lint -- --fix` for autofixable rules.
3. Anything `--fix` did NOT resolve is a finding that needs judgment (suppress vs refactor vs config change). Group findings by file/rule and file a single board task per group — never one task per warning.
4. Disk / log / worktree growth checks (the kit accumulates these silently):
   - Worktree sprawl: count directories under `.odin/worktrees/` and flag if >10 or any older than 7 days (stale).
   - Log growth: `du -sh .odin/logs/ taskit/taskit-backend/logs/` — flag if either >100MB.
   - Proof/slop cruft: `du -sh .proof slops .verify-logs` — flag untracked growth >50MB.
   - Untracked sprawl: `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | wc -l` — a large count is a hygiene smell.
5. After autofixes, run `scripts/verify.sh odin backend` to confirm nothing broke. Formatting/import fixes must not change behavior.

Acceptance
- `ruff check odin/ taskit/taskit-backend/ harness_usage_status/` exits 0, or every remaining finding has a filed task.
- Applied autofixes are committed in logical chunks (import fix, format fix, eslint fix), not one giant commit.
- Each judgment-only finding has a task with WHY + Evidence + one concrete Acceptance check.
- Disk/log/worktree findings (if any) are filed as tasks carrying the measured numbers.

Verify (attach as proof)
- `ruff check odin/ taskit/taskit-backend/ harness_usage_status/` exit 0 + the tail.
- `git diff --stat` of the autofix commits.
- `scripts/verify.sh odin backend` summary table (green).
- For each filed task: its title + the one-line finding it owns.

Working protocol
- First principles: fix the CAUSE, not the symptom. If a lint rule fires repeatedly, fix the pattern, don't suppress it.
- Autofixes only; never hand-edit to "make lint pass."
- Attach proof to `.proof/task-<id>/proof.md` and post a summary comment.
- Do not create or switch branches; edit files in your worktree.

presets.title: Security Audit
presets.description: Use skill /hk-security-audit to perform Security Audit. Objective: run scripts/security_audit.py over the repo and verify each hit by reading the code. Scope: the repo or the path the user names. Findings: leaked secrets, endpoints without auth, credential mounts, token handling, sandbox egress posture, subprocess calls with shell=True. Report: one HTML page at writeup/security-audit-<scope>.html, up to ten findings. The skill body under docs/skills/audits/hk-security-audit/SKILL.md is the live copy.
